title: Nature time-lapse — a mountain sunrise revealed by parting cloud
useCase: Documentary open, travel brand, ambient screensaver

anchor.subject: A jagged snow-capped mountain ridge
anchor.scene: High alpine valley, low cloud sea below the peaks
anchor.motion: Cloud sea drifts, peaks emerge as the first light lands, stars fade out
anchor.camera: Locked-off wide from a ridge, subtle time-lapse speed
anchor.light: Blue hour transitioning to alpenglow gold on the summits

seedance-2.0.prompt: A jagged snow-capped mountain ridge stands above a sea of low cloud in a high alpine valley. In a time-lapse progression, the cloud sea drifts and thins, the first warm light touches the summits and moves down the rock faces, and the last stars fade from a deep blue sky into pale dawn. The camera is locked off on a neighbouring ridge with no movement, capturing the entire scene at a subtle accelerated pace. Cold blue shadows give way to alpenglow gold, with realistic atmospheric haze between ridgelines. Photorealistic landscape cinematography, high dynamic range, no lens flare, no added birds, no fast cloud stutter, no text or watermark.
seedance-2.0.notes: Say 'time-lapse' and give the light sequence three stages; otherwise you get a static 8 s shot.
